## Example 2: Does place matter? 

Are urban residents more likely to believe that climate change is caused by humans, as compared to rural residents?
    
Q) **What is our testable hypothesis? Type your Null and Alternate Hypothesis**


## Run the following Desriptive Analysis


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(dat_2prop, aes(x = area_type, fill = climhuman)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "Area Type", y = "Proportion (Climate change caused by humans)") +
  coord_flip()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lab6_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


Based on the graph, what is your guess? Write in 1 sentence

## Calculate Difference in Proportion

This analysis is akin to running hypothesis testing for 2 nominal variables.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dat_2prop |>
  group_by(area_type) |>
  summarize(prop_clim = sum(climhuman=="yes")/length(climhuman))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
# A tibble: 2 × 2
  area_type prop_clim
  <fct>         <dbl>
1 urban          0.75
2 rural          0.6 
```
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
d_hat <- dat_2prop |>
  specify(climhuman ~ area_type, success = "yes") |>
  calculate(stat = "diff in props", order = c("urban", "rural"))
d_hat
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
Response: climhuman (factor)
Explanatory: area_type (factor)
# A tibble: 1 × 1
   stat
  <dbl>
1  0.15
```
:::
:::



## Calculate Null Distribution


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(2018) 

null_distn_two_props <- dat_2prop |>
  specify(climhuman ~ area_type, success = "yes") |>
  hypothesize(null = "independence") |>
  generate(reps = 10000) |>
  calculate(stat = "diff in props", order = c("urban", "rural"))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}
```
Setting `type = "permute"` in `generate()`.
```
:::
:::


## Calculate P value


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
null_distn_two_props |>
  visualize() +
  shade_p_value(obs_stat = d_hat, direction = "greater")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lab6_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
pvalue <- null_distn_two_props  |>
  get_pvalue(obs_stat = d_hat, direction = "greater")
pvalue
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
# A tibble: 1 × 1
  p_value
    <dbl>
1  0.0869
```
:::
:::


## Calculate Confidence Interval


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
boot_distn_two_props <- dat_2prop |>
  specify(climhuman ~ area_type, success = "yes") |>
  generate(reps = 10000) |>
  calculate(stat = "diff in props", order = c("urban", "rural"))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}
```
Setting `type = "bootstrap"` in `generate()`.
```
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
ci <- boot_distn_two_props |>
  get_ci()
ci
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
# A tibble: 1 × 2
  lower_ci upper_ci
     <dbl>    <dbl>
1  -0.0429    0.341
```
:::
:::


## Draw Confidence Interval


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
boot_distn_two_props |>
  visualize() +
  shade_ci(endpoints = ci) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             color = "black")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](lab6_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::
